name: Federalist Party of Kachakonia
description:
One of the youngest political forces, for many years it was on the margins of big politics. The last elections brought a breakthrough, as the party surprisingly achieved the third best result and have currently the largest parliamentary representation in its history. 
    Their main concern is so-called Pankachakism, an ideology that claims that all people that speak kachakonic languages are in fact one nation and should unite into one federal state. In international politics, they are against cooperation with the Matheuchelles and claim that instead we should focus on close cooperation with the countries of the region, mainly those from the Kachakophone sphere. 
    Economically, they are strong supporters of the free market, and in the ideological sphere they represent a moderately conservative position. These radical ideas gain the greatest support among young people from large cities.
